name: Caleb Rill
source_profile: ● Caleb Rill (CG) is a charismatic young Ranger and expert tracker who has become something of a folk hero among the smaller ranching settlements. He maintains friendly relations with several Varkesh and Rathen clans and has occasionally refused to pursue individuals he believes have been wrongfully accused.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 20 (source excerpt; may be partial)
